title: feat(auth)!: a managed environment adds pending, SSO-only people, and ban works without the admin plugin
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_

Fixes #33181

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: ban works without the admin plugin — `admin/ban-user` now works without the admin plugin, and a banned row is refused a session, with the admin plugin's own `403 BANNED_USER` answer; both ban doors answered `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` there. Widened: two doors, `POST /admin/add-sso-user` and `POST /admin/import-sso-users` (cloud-managed environments only; `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` elsewhere); the `idp_pending` value of `sys_user.source`, which every password door and every session refuses; the auth plugin's optional `environmentUserHost` option; `AuthManager#isAdminPluginMounted()`; and the exports of `pending-sso-marker`, `environment-user-host` and `pending-sso-users`. The cloud-managed refusals of `create-user`, `import-users` and the invitation doors point to Setup → Users.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches the admin user doors, the ban doors or the cloud-managed refusals; `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` gains the two doors, the pending state, the host option and the ban change in this change.

> **Owes a contract review.** This draft owes a contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (narrowing arm) from the new review agent, and is not landed before it.
>
> **Wording is provisional.** The four cloud-managed `409` sentences (invitation, invitation link, create-user, import-users) are this PR's own text, kept in one block in `cloud-managed.ts`. They are swapped for the maintainer's text once it is quoted on the card.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：托管环境的管理员可以在「设置 → 用户」通过两个新接口直接加人或导入 CSV，同时带上岗位、权限集和上级；这些人以「待激活」（`idp_pending`）状态存在，没有密码，在通过云端登录绑定之前，任何设密码、重置密码和其他登录方式都会被拒绝。
- 为什么改：卡片 #33181（cloud#4465 子项 1a）：种子数据和审批流需要在员工第一次登录前就能指向他们；Free/Team 托管环境没有 admin 插件，原来既不能加人也不能停用人。
- 风险与回滚：patch 级；对**未装 admin 插件**的部署是破坏性收紧（BREAKING）：停用/恢复（ban/unban）在那里开始生效，被停用的账号拿不到会话；装了 admin 插件的部署行为不变。其余都是新增；回滚就是还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts`（两个入口）、`user-session-admission.ts`（会话拒绝）、`admin-ban-endpoints.ts` 与 `user-ban-write.ts`（无插件时的停用）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/pending-sso-users.test.ts src/pending-sso-seams.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：确认四句托管 409 文案（或等维护者原文引到卡片上后由席位替换）；本 PR 还欠新评审代理按 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 的合约评审，评审通过后由席位落地。

## What changes

**Adding a pending person (managed only).** Two platform-admin-gated doors, both mounted by the plugin itself and needing no admin plugin:

| Door | Takes | Answers |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `POST /admin/add-sso-user` | `email`, `name`, optional `positions`, `permissionSets`, `manager` (the manager's email); a closed key set | `201`; `200` with `alreadyPending` for a person still pending (the host is told again); `409` for an address already held by someone not pending |
| `POST /admin/import-sso-users` | `{ csv }` (columns `email`, `name`, `positions`, `permission_sets`, `manager_id`, lists `;`-separated) or `{ rows }`, at most 500 | `200` with `summary` and one result per row; a bad row fails alone, managers resolve in a second pass |

Off a managed environment both answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. The row is written by one engine insert as the system, attributed to the administrator (the AI service-account door's pattern), so it is born `idp_pending`: no `sys_account`, `email_verified: false`, and no moment where it reads `env_native`. Positions and permission sets are inserted under the caller's own execution context (create-user's grant seam, one unit of work), membership comes from create-user's organization bind, and the manager link is `admin/set-user-manager`'s. An audit row `user.admin_added_pending` is written after the commit.

**What a pending row is refused.** `admin/set-user-password`, `set-initial-password` (judged after the body is read, through an optional `beforeWrite` on `runSetInitialPassword`), `/reset-password` and `/phone-number/reset-password` answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with their own sentence (`pending-sso-marker.ts`), in every mode. Session creation answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` (`user-session-admission.ts`, composed into `session.create.before` after the AI service-account refusal, and reading the user row in that refusal's one read). The first sign-in through the platform identity provider binds to the row (implicit-linking rule 2) and `stampIdentitySource` moves it to `idp_provisioned` in `account.create.after`, before that sign-in's session; an enterprise provider does not bind (rule 1).

**Ban works without the admin plugin.** `admin/ban-user` and `admin/unban-user` no longer answer `501` there: the ban columns are written through the data engine (`engineUserBanWriter`, the vendor-shaped write mapped to `banned` / `ban_reason` / `ban_expires` / `updated_at`; the last-administrator guard judges engine writes in every context), sessions are revoked as before, and `session.create.before` refuses a banned row with the vendor's own `403 BANNED_USER` code and sentence, lifting an expired ban at sign-in as the vendor does. It runs only when the admin plugin is not mounted (`AuthManager#isAdminPluginMounted()`), so a kernel with the plugin answers exactly as before.

**The host seam.** `environmentUserHost` (auth plugin option, read per call) is told `userAdded` after the person's unit of work commits, and asked `userDeactivated` / `userReactivated` before the ban or unban write. It is never called inside a transaction (execution terms, comment 6870710213). A member that throws `EnvironmentUserHostRefusal` (`409`, an organization owner or admin; `403`, for example `DEVELOPER_ORGANIZATION_MEMBER_LIMIT_REACHED`) refuses the operation with its own status, code and sentence. A refused deactivation or reactivation writes nothing. A refused add takes that person back out (grants, membership, row) and fails alone on its import row. A refused re-add of a still-pending person leaves that row as it was. Any other throw never undoes or blocks: the answer carries `host: { notified: false, reason: 'host_failed' | 'no_host' }` and the failure is logged at `warn`. On the ban doors `host` appears only when a host is wired. Every event carries `actorCloudUserId`, the `account_id` of the administrator's linked `objectstack-cloud` account, read from `sys_account` and never from the request (ruling 3). It is absent where there is no such link.

**Elsewhere.** `sys_user.source` gains the option `idp_pending` ("Pending SSO Sign-In") with its description; the eleven translation bundles are regenerated with `check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. The cloud-managed `409` sentences point to Setup → Users (provisional, above). Route ledger rows for the two doors; the tenant audit census regenerated for the new write sites; `authentication.mdx` documents it all.

**Unchanged:** every `env_native` and `idp_provisioned` row at every door; `create-user` and `import-users` off a managed environment; the vendor's ban enforcement where the admin plugin is mounted.

## Breaking

**BREAKING** for a deployment without the better-auth admin plugin (`auth.plugins.admin` off and SCIM off): `admin/ban-user` now works without the admin plugin, and a banned row is refused a session, with the admin plugin's own `403 BANNED_USER` code and sentence; `admin/unban-user` lifts the ban there too. Level stays `patch`. ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset.

## Why

Card #33181, child 1a of objectstack-ai/cloud#4465: a managed environment needs people to exist, with their positions, permission sets and manager, before their first sign-in, so seeds and approval flows can name them; on Free and Team hosted kernels (no admin plugin) there was no add door and no working deactivation. Seat rulings on the card: claim amendments 6869729952 and 6870557312.

## Verification

All readings at head `be43f4e1`, one commit on `origin/main` `7257f57a`.

<details><summary>Measured at main first</summary>

At `origin/main` `88355328`, managed (`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`) with the admin plugin off, as on a Free or Team hosted kernel: `admin/create-user` and `admin/import-users` answer the managed `409`, and `admin/ban-user` / `admin/unban-user` answer `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, so no door adds or deactivates a person there. `admin/set-user-password` writes a credential on a credential-less `env_native` row, which is why the pending marker is its own value. The platform provider (`objectstack-cloud`) binds to an unverified credential-less row and `stampIdentitySource` restamps it `idp_provisioned`, while an enterprise provider is refused (rule 1). The new test files fail against main's wiring.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each leg mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, red recorded, restored to HEAD)</summary>

- A1 set-user-password pending arm: 2 failed. A2 set-initial-password arm: 2 failed. A3 reset-door arm: 2 failed.
- A4 session refusal of a pending row: 3 failed. A5 session refusal of a banned row: 7 failed. A6 `enforceBan` wiring (admin plugin mounted or not): 4 failed. A8 a user-row read fault answers 503: 1 failed. A16 the one session read carries the admission columns: 6 failed.
- A7 ban writer selection: 2 failed. A13 the engine ban writer refuses an unknown field: 1 failed.
- A9 off a managed environment: 1 failed. A10 an address held by a non-pending row: 2 failed. A11 an unknown add key: 1 failed. A12 an unknown import column: 1 failed. A15 the marker on the insert itself: 7 failed.
- A14 the host told on ban: 3 failed.
- B1 a host refusal stops the ban: 1 failed. B2 stops the unban: 1 failed. B3 only `403` / `409` refusals are honoured: 1 failed. B4 a typed refusal is recognised at all: 5 failed. B5 a refused add takes the person back out: 2 failed. B6 a refused re-add fails the request: 1 failed. B7 the cloud id is read only from the `objectstack-cloud` account: 3 failed. B8 the ban event carries the cloud id: 2 failed. B9 the take-back removes grants and membership: 1 failed.
- The dogfood sweeps' classification of the two new doors: both sweeps failed by name before the entries were added (`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/add-sso-user`, `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-sso-users`), and pass after.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates and suites</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 108 families. All 108 ran with `</dev/null`, with exit codes recorded first, and `--ran` reconciles: `✓ 108 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 108 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 108 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. After the dogfood-table change, the gates that read test sources were re-run: `check-issue-citations`, `check-comment-mask-adoption`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:test-source-alias`, all exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` built with declarations: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` full suite: 270 files, 5169 passed, 10 skipped. `@objectstack/platform-objects`: 122 files, 1958 passed.
- `@objectstack/dogfood`: the full run had two failures, the admin-route sweeps naming the two new doors. Both are now classified (ADR-0068 gate first; the admin gets `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` off a managed environment), and the two sweep files re-run green (15 passed). The rest of the run was green: 461 files passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The cloud-managed `409` sentences are provisional until the objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 text is quoted on the card; the seat lands only after that quote or Tesla's acceptance of this wording.
- An unreadable `source` at the three password-door pending arms falls through to the existing arms (the pending arm does not narrow main on a read fault). Session admission refuses `503` on a read fault, as the AI service-account refusal composed before it does.
- Managed, a pending caller without platform-admin standing meets the cloud-managed `set-initial-password` refusal first; a pending caller with that standing meets the pending refusal.
- Follow-up card drafted for the seat to file (`out/33181-fu-seam.md`): a pending-only remove door that cancels the invitation, and where the durable outbox with retry and per-row invitation status lives (host-owned or a framework object). Both are execution terms in comment 6870710213 that this PR does not cover.
- Follow-ups for #33186, not in this PR: Setup → Users has no console entry for the two doors yet, and the `sys_user` `ban_user` / `unban_user` actions keep `requiresFeature: 'admin'`, so the console hides them on Free and Team kernels although the doors now answer there.
- The non-English bundles carry the English option label the generator writes until translated.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` untouched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched; the translation bundles were regenerated by their generator.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section is the frame's Chinese summary.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
